subject: HOA budget projections — Friday meeting
body:
Attached are the projections for the HOA in advance of our meeting on Friday.

Yearly bills:
Water: $3720
PG & E: $2100
Recology: $1640 (likely to go up more)
BofA fees: $192
Insurance: $12,366 (likely to go up more)
Current balance: $1754.24

Next insurance is due in October: $6183 -> we each will owe $500 + monthly dues
PDF shows three projections (HOA as is, $25 increase, $50 increase).

Everything is getting more expensive. If we do not increase dues it means we face more or larger special assessments if insurance, other services are raised OR there are outstanding issues with the building.

Upcoming assessments (2026-2027)

HOA (keeping costs as is):
We each owe $500 + monthly dues for insurance in October 2026.
We each owe $900 + monthly dues for insurance in April 2027.

HOA (if we raise to $300 in June):
We each owe $400 + monthly dues for insurance in October 2026.
We each owe $650 + monthly dues for insurance in April 2027.

HOA (if we raise to $325 in June):
We each owe $200 + monthly dues for insurance in October 2026.
We each owe $550 + monthly dues for insurance in April 2027.

On my list for meeting:

Painting curb out front -> costs $750
Possible tree trim (we haven't done this in a while and should look in front if we need it, we used to do this once a year)
